entities.name: Killian Lu
entities.description: A human graduate mage-student of Silverquill at Strixhaven, driven by his father, who learns white magic and supports others.

entities.name: Embrose Lu
entities.description: Silverquill Dean and Killian's stern father.

entities.name: Dina
entities.description: Dryad student, Killian's partner, who cured him.

entities.name: Professor Vess
entities.description: Professor who tasked the surviving students.

entities.name: Nassari
entities.description: Compleated faculty member who distracted Rootha.

entities.name: Crownflower Majen
entities.description: Silkmeadow delegate who defeated Killian in a duel.

entities.name: Biblioplex
entities.description: Library holding the Invocation of the Founders.

entities.name: Forum of Amity
entities.description: Place where Killian mentored students and intervened in a duel.

entities.name: Invocation of the Founders
entities.description: Magic that repelled the Phyrexian attackers.

entities.name: Naming Tithe
entities.description: Ritual Embrose conducted to restore formal order.

events.summary: Killian's ink bolt disrupts Dina's resurrection spell, creating a swamp monster; they defeat it and Dina heals his fatal wound.
events.quote: Killian and Dina managed to defeat the monster

events.summary: Killian is tempted by an Oriq agent and drinks a potion that shuts out empathy, then learns white magic with Doco's help and wins his father's approval.
events.quote: he just in time learned to use white magic

events.summary: Phyrexians burn through Strixhaven's defenses and Vess sends the students to find the Invocation; Embrose fights compleated faculty.
events.quote: Embrose arrived to fight off the full group of compleated faculty

events.summary: The Invocation is activated; Quint's spark ignites and he planeswalks away, but the attackers are repelled.
events.quote: Quint's spark ignited, and he planeswalked away

events.summary: Killian is defeated in a formal duel by Crownflower Majen and healed by Verdis.
events.quote: was defeated by Crownflower Majen of Silkmeadow

events.summary: Killian intervenes in the binding duel by creating his own sigil, reshaping its terms.
events.quote: Killian intervened by creating his own sigil to bear witness

relations.quote: having the Silverquill Dean, Embrose Lu , as a father
Killian is in a relationship with Dina .
at the Silverquill College of Strixhaven University
